def: to whisper; by implication, to mumble aspell (as a magician)

occurrences.text: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.
All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
